policies.evidencePolicy: A behavioral record is a test-runner command (swift test ..., bun test ..., vitest run ..., or mise run <task containing test>) with exit code 0 and every count > 0. For XCTest, record the 'Executed N tests, with 0 failures' line with N > 0. For swift-testing, record the 'Test run with N tests passed' line with N > 0, and only when the filter selects swift-testing tests. mise run web:check is not a behavioral record. Record bun test src and vitest run separately. An env-gated skip is never evidence. For the live agent-gateway test (LiveServedAgenticSearchTests), record only the XCTest 'Executed N' count (N > 0) of the positive run; its swift-testing 0-tests line is not counted. The P2 residual Sandbox denial record (sandbox-denial-classes.log) is evidence of the amended gate, not a behavioral test record. Tee every command into the plan's evidence directory, and give the complete log path and the final exit status in each record. Logs from earlier sessions are history only.
policies.evidenceLayout: Evidence lives under tmp/release-0-1-17/<planId-prefix> (P1..P4), which tmp/ makes gitignored. In this run, P2 writes to tmp/release-0-1-17/P2/accept/ and P4 writes to tmp/release-0-1-17/P4/. A plan never writes another plan's evidence directory; P4 only cites P2's sandbox-denial-classes.log in the index table.
policies.editProtocol: Follow the index 'Edit protocol'. Record pre/post shasum for each edit in the plan's hashes.txt. Write an immutable intent snapshot, intent.md, before the first edit. On drift, re-read, re-apply only your own intent and note the drift. Edit only your own writePaths. A peer's compile or lint failure is not a blocker: rerun after the peer lands, and cross-plan fixes go to P4. No git write operations, no worktrees and no branches. Do not create or touch .riela/. Each plan updates only the Progress Log in its own plan file (P4 also fills the index). Never print OPENROUTER_API_KEY or any other credential; use a presence check only. Never copy machine-local absolute paths into committed files.
policies.literalPolicy: The repository pre-commit hook rejects staged text containing absolute path literals rooted in the macOS users directory, the Linux home directory or the Nix store. No committed file written by any plan, including plan files, may contain such a literal. Use /opt/example/..., /srv/example/... or runtime-built paths. Guard regexes use character classes such as /U[s]ers/ so their own text stays clean. P4 scans the whole release diff against releaseBase.
policies.artifactPolicy: Artifact roots: tmp/release-0-1-17/<P#> for every dispatched plan, plus web/dist and web/src-tauri/target for P4 (vite build output from mise run web:check and cargo output from mise run tauri:check). All are gitignored. Authored files (sources, tests, version files, README.md, plan files) are never artifact roots.
policies.protectedPaths: No dispatched plan edits any of the following: .riela/, api-key-expiration work, NoteStoreSchema or any store schema, web/src/styles.css, web/src/workspace.css, web/src/index.tsx, web/src/App.tsx, web/index.html, Sources/AppCore/AgentGatewaySubscription.swift, Sources/AppCore/ClaudeSubscriptionExecution.swift, Sources/AppServer/*, mise.toml, docker/, web/src-tauri/capabilities/, web/src-tauri/local-service/, any impl-plans/active/*-dispatch.json, any design-docs/ file, signing, notarization or cask scripts, or ../homebrew-tap. The session-281 design edit, the plans and this manifest are committed before fanout, so P2's design-diff.log and P4's guard-design-docs.log must be empty.
policies.releasePolicy: No release, tag, GitHub release, signing, notarization, cask or tap action. The operator runs .agents/skills/macos-cask-release/SKILL.md after this run.
policies.liveGatePolicy: Live agent-gateway runs need OPENROUTER_API_KEY, network access and a non-nested Seatbelt context. A missing key, a provider failure after three attempts, or a nested-sandbox 'sandbox-exec:' failure is recorded as blocked with the exact sanitized reason, never as passed. search:test-live needs Docker through colima (mise run search:docker, search:up, search:test-live, then search:down); if that is unavailable, record 'blocked: <exact error>'. tauri:check needs the gitignored local-service sidecar; if it is missing, record blocked, and do not rebuild it.
policies.escalationPolicy: Operator decision of 2026-10-06 (design-docs/user-qa/ai-agent-runtime-and-ui.md, 'Served sandbox: residual non-fatal denials'; AI13 'Diagnosis gate'). No plan adds, removes or widens any (allow ...) rule in a sandbox profile in this run, including the AI13 bounded escalations. The residual non-fatal denials (file-read-data, file-read-xattr, file-write-* outside the workspace, mach-lookup, system-socket, user-preference-read) stay denied. A denial is fatal only if the live served agenticSearch test fails because of it. If the live test fails with a sandbox-start diagnostic, or with a denial class outside the residual set in its window, P2 stops as 'blocked: fatal sandbox denial <operation class> <path or service class>' for an operator decision, and adds no allowance. If it fails with a provider or network diagnostic and no new denial class, P2 retries at most twice more, each in a new bounded window, before recording 'blocked: live provider failure'.

intentionalTradeoffs: Residual non-fatal Sandbox denials remain in the log by design. A clean log is not required.

A live provider or network failure blocks P2 after three attempts rather than being reported as passed.
supportedEdgeCases: A gateway configured through a Homebrew bin symlink into the keg.
A missing gateway binary in served mode -> unavailable -> 'agent runtime is unavailable'.
A passing live run whose window contains residual denials -> accepted, with the classes and counts recorded.
A passing live run whose window contains no denials -> accepted, recorded as 0 residual denials.
A failing live run with a sandbox-start diagnostic or a new denial class -> blocked for an operator decision, with no allowance added.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Any sandbox allowance, including the AI13 bounded escalations (deferred to a future gateway version failure and an operator decision).
A dark-theme switch or legacy dark base styling.
tauri:check off macOS or without the sidecar, live tests without OPENROUTER_API_KEY or network, and search:test-live without Docker/colima (all recorded as blocked, never as passed).
residualRisks: Low: the live gates depend on OPENROUTER_API_KEY, network access, the OpenRouter provider and a non-nested Seatbelt context. A provider failure blocks P2 rather than passing it.
Low: residual denial counts can drift between runs. Drift alone is not a failure; a new class is reported explicitly.
Low: log show may need privileges or may lag. The plan waits 5 seconds and records a tool error as blocked.
Low: search:test-live depends on Docker/colima, and tauri:check depends on the locally built sidecar.
Low: the pre-commit hook script was not read. P4's release-wide literal guard is the proxy, and the final commit itself is the real check.
